reading_issues: PDF is a rasterised SnowPilot graph with no text layer; header and notes read visually from the embedded 994x840 image. Observer not given (header shows org 'Banff Visitor Safety'). Site name taken from filename; header pit name is 'Bottom of West Bowl'. Density column (rho) values (90, 100, 190, 280, 230 kg/m3, top to bottom) are overprinted at layer boundaries and appear to be one value per layer, probably SnowPilot-estimated rather than measured. Table surface row shows only a size of 1 (no form). Layer 35-41 primary glyph is a three-circle cluster (MFcl) with secondary open circle (MF); moisture shown as D (dry) for all layers. PF=70 recorded as foot_pen_cm and verbatim in header_other. Specifics text is cut off at the right edge of the header.
